name: Project X-Nexus Executor
changelog: V1.10.0: Display-aware FPS shortcuts fill a custom target using the selected monitor refresh rate or twice that rate. CPU and memory charts show the last 60 seconds. Optional five-minute PC usage recording continues across pages and while minimized, stops automatically or manually, and reports valid sampled averages and peaks. Export the latest in-memory recording to CSV with the saved FPS cap as context. Performance now has Overview and Activity tabs. Actual game FPS is not measured.
